newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps mixed - moderate gains, losses.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps mixed - moderate gains, losses.

text.p: European oil swaps were mixed on Monday. Heavy fuel edged up $1 a tonne, Brent CFDs gained several cents while gasoline slipped $1-2 and naphtha eased back very narrowly.

Brent CFDs for July 7-11 pushed up to +3 cents against August Brent from flat on Friday while July 14-18 firmed to -10/11 cents against August. July 21-25 actually weakened to -20 cents from -15/16 cents as did July 28 to August 1 down to -21 cents against August.
A July 10-11 CFD traded at -2 cents against August.

Heavy fuel oil ticked up $1 or so although there was little fundamental news to back a gain. Traders said the market was slow with July valued around $85.25 and August at $85.75. Wet barges were heard bid earlier at $85 and later $86 was done fob.
Gas oil crack spreads were steady with 4Q at $4.45, 1Q98 at $4.60 and 2Q at $4.10.

Gasoline swaps eased back with July pegged at $185 from $186.50 with August and September showing backwardation of $1 a piece. Dealers said activity was slender with the market looking for direction from the U.S.
Naphtha swaps remained in contango, but July eased back about 50 cents as a rally in Brent crude appeared to subside.
